accounting_scope: Implemented shell total is only source-declared RTL arrays/registers. Inherited bank, arithmetic boundary, writer and archived control metadata terms are separately enumerated but excluded while real services and bridges are unbound. Physical mapping and generated storage remain UNMEASURED.

arithmetic_service_proposal_not_live_v3.binding: UNBOUND; archived stage-v2 software/dataflow candidate is not a no-ready hardware service
arithmetic_service_proposal_not_live_v3.excluded_old_final_return_fifo_reason: Stage-v2 blocking 1557-bit FinalReturn stream is archived only; no v3 live full-result FIFO.

first_use_contracts: Q64 issue uses pre-edge free count; same-edge commit cannot supply credit.
Return has ret_valid and no ret_ready. Matching pre-edge RESERVED slot is written at every valid return edge; unexpected return is terminal protocol error.
Q64 payload is unreset and read only after a registered RETURNED state, at least the edge following return.
D4 payload is unreset and read only after return plus ordered physical commit publishes READY; canceled traces are never read.
Trace SENDING frees only on matching post-write_response ACK; command/B stalls cannot gate arithmetic return writes.

PS/lane_bad old-operand access is an unbound arithmetic-service obligation: g0 and inactive/failed lanes must emit canonical +0 without PS read; every active g>0 read follows prior same-tile physical commit.
Wq/Ws/Aq/As/FP first-use guards remain source requirements from archived stage-v2 ledger; no v3 bank implementation or physical port proof exists.
